items.claim: Mackenzie Dern has significantly improved her striking and elevated her game since her losses to Amanda Lemos and Jessica Andrade.
items.quote: you can tell Dern is definitely improved from those two fights and has really elevated her game a lot since then. And the striking's come a long way.

items.claim: Gillian Robertson has had a lot of success since dropping down to the 115-pound strawweight division.
items.quote: Gillian Robertson, a lot of success since coming down to 115.

items.claim: Gillian Robertson's recent win streak is somewhat deceiving because many of her wins have come against older or declining fighters.
items.quote: the win streak's a little bit deceiving for Robertson.
